description: Fahrradabstellanlagen Standorte Wien is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MA 46 - Verkehrsorganisation und technische Verkehrsangelegenheiten. Bicycle parking, covered bicycle parking, bicycle garage and bicycle box, Locations, Vienna. Coverage: MA 46 - Verkehrsorganisation und technische Verkehrsangelegenheiten. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle parking facilities Vienna" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MA 46 - Verkehrsorganisation und technische Verkehrsangelegenheiten. Its keywords include Radparkplatz, überdachte Fahrradabstellanlage, Radabstellanlage, Abstellmöglichkeit, Radbox, Fahrradbox. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS, PNG, JSON, KML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
